results.title: Strong per-facility monitoring, no stated unified cross-network view
results.closest_fact_claim: In December 2025, TCI opened a new 1.5-lakh-sq.-ft. cold chain facility at Taj Nagar, Gurugram, featuring SCADA-based monitoring, VESDA early smoke detection, 600+ CCTV cameras, and 500 kW rooftop solar, with multi-temperature (frozen/chilled/ambient) zones. Nationwide managed warehousing now exceeds 16 million sq. ft.

results.title: Four-standard pharma compliance burden without stated automated audit reporting
results.closest_fact_claim: TCI follows compliance with FDA, FSSAI, NBC, and CMVR standards with internal audits, and serves fruits & veggies, dairy, meat, aqua, frozen food, confectionery, floriculture, pharmaceuticals, and health sciences verticals.
